title: Accelerating LLM Pretraining with Zeroth-Order Curvature on Idle Serving Compute
abstract: arXiv:2611.02688v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM pretraining is increasingly compute-intensive, while substantial inference serving compute remains idle during off-peak periods. However, such serving hardware is difficult to use for conventional first-order training due to its memory, networking and other system requirements. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a natural interface to this forward-only compute resource, but its gradient estimates break down in pretraining. Unlike fine-tuning, which can confine updates to a small parameter subspace, pretraining must update every parameter, and the alignment of a ZO gradient estimate with the true gradient shrinks as the number of updated parameters grows. We make a different observation: noisy ZO estimates can still provide useful curvature information, even when they are too inaccurate to serve as gradients. Based on this insight, we propose ZO-Curv, which leverages idle forward-only devices to estimate curvature and use

translated_title: 利用空闲推理服务算力上的零阶曲率加速大语言模型预训练
translated_abstract: 大语言模型预训练的计算需求日益增长，而大量推理服务的算力在非高峰时段处于闲置状态。然而，由于其内存、网络等系统需求，这些服务硬件难以用于传统的一阶训练。零阶（ZO）优化为这种仅前向传播的计算资源提供了天然的接口，但其梯度估计在预训练中会失效。与微调可以将更新限制在较小参数子空间不同，预训练必须更新每一个参数，而随着被更新参数数量的增长，零阶梯度估计与真实梯度的一致性会随之下降。我们提出了一个不同的观察：即使噪声较大的零阶估计不足以作为梯度使用，它们仍然能够提供有用的曲率信息。基于这一洞察，我们提出了ZO-Curv，它利用空闲的仅前向传播设备来估计曲率并用于……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出ZO-Curv方法，发现零阶优化估计即使无法准确充当梯度，仍可提供有用的曲率信息，从而利用空闲的推理服务算力加速大语言模型预训练。
en_tdlr: ZO-Curv shows that noisy zeroth-order estimates, while too inaccurate to serve as gradients, still carry useful curvature information, enabling idle forward-only inference hardware to accelerate LLM pretraining.
